notes.title: Broaden your horizon
notes.content:
A new internal music track has been added called Princess At The Gate by Imphenzia that has a few tricks up its sleeves. This tune will for sure open up your views and broaden your horizon.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28339483/97f5f1a4774cab8ad7ad1ab11517fab328b25957.jpg[/img]

The main menu has also been turned around in this patch to face the direction of your configured forward.

Also, a new disco mode has been added that allows you to go to the disco alone, without any other distracting dancing character there. Good for your own contemplation over some nice own music or a good YouTube video.

notes.title: Christmas is coming!
notes.content:
Do you feel ready for Christmas?

If you ever find your way out of the disco you will see that the Christmas tree has already been taken inside and is ready for you to be decorated. Decorating a Christmas tree takes good practice so what better opportunity is there to get your skills up to excellence before you go ahead with your own tree back home?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28339483/fdc077df097494538a9dd61c4861a838aad885f2.png[/img]

Pick up and place Christmas balls with the trigger button on the right controller and draw tinsel with the trigger button on your left controller. Be sure to not drop those balls, they are fragile! If you mess up the tinsel, you can always reset it with the grip button.

[b]Merry Christmas to you all![/b]

notes.title: Playlists & YouTube
notes.content:
This update brings you support for playlists (.pls) and music selection from YouTube.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28339483/533db4f75188a72357967d19affcd10998e1a891.png[/img]

The playlist support allows you to select .pls files on your local computer that can make you stay longer on the dance floor while listening to your favorite music lists. Take a look at [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PLS_(file_format)]Wikipedia[/url] if you would like to know more about the .pls file format.

The other major update this release is the ability to search YouTube for music and play that on the dance floor. YouTube links can also be placed in playlists if you want. A bit caution about the video playback is that it requires some computing power so if you don’t have the best of machines you might not want to fill the dancefloor with too many characters when playing video. That could make the music stutter a bit.

While the dance floor was closed when we installed the new video support, the girls took the time to go shopping some new cloths. You can check out their new outfits in their customization menu.

notes.title: Major character upgrade
notes.content:
The characters now look better than ever. An upgraded rendering engine for the characters has been added which both improves the looks and the performance.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28339483/092730df606c9a6b736b5b64abfe2d659a61fdd3.png[/img]

The rendering performance in general has also been improved which will give you a more stable frame rate.

notes.title: Character customization
notes.content:
Personal Disco VR just got an update that now allows you to customize the appearance of your dance partner characters. Create prettier, ugly or why not a weird alien character if you prefer that. It is up to you!
